Shyamsiddhi Math

শ্যামসিদ্ধি মঠ

Colonial Bengal · 1836

About this place

The inscription attributes construction to Shambhunath Majumder in 1836. The tall, tapering form gives the monument its character. Comparing this single spire with the pair at Sonarang is a way to see how 19th-century patrons used height and silhouette in village settings.

Check locally for the public approach and avoid leaning against the masonry.
